system.bonus: Choose a type of weapon (such as Common, Sidearm, Longarm, etc).. You gain +1 to hit and damage with the chosen weapon type. You may select this feat multiple times, selecting a different weapon type each time. You may select this feat a second time for the same weapon type at 8th level, a third time at 11th level, a fourth time at 14th level, and a fifth time at 17th level.
